title: 'Give a friendly unit +3 Might this turn' is not applied
expected: Card def (riftbound-cards/src/cards/ogs/gentlemens-duel.ts) has no explicit abilities; they come from the text parser. In parser/impl/effects.ts:146 parseEffect(cleaned) runs on the whole text BEFORE the '. Then ' split at line 154, and parseFightEffect (parser/impl/effects-damage.ts:216) matches only on the end-anchored regex /deal damage equal to their Mights to each other\.?$/ — so the full string 'Give a friendly unit +3 [Might] this turn. Then choose an enemy unit. They deal damage…' matches as a single fight effect with default friendly/enemy targets (lines 222-234), discarding the +3 Might clause. Verified by running parseAbilities on the card text: output is exactly {effect:{type:'fight',attacker:{controller:'friendly',type:'unit'},defender:{controller:'enemy',type:'unit'}},timing:'action',type:'spell'} — no modify-might step. Matches test.failing in riftbound-engine/src/__tests__/cards/ogs-008-024.test.ts.
observed: After resolution Rengar's might stayed 6 (no mightModifier in meta, UI shows 6); enemy Pit Crew received 6 damage not 9. Registered ability is only {type:'fight', attacker:friendly unit, defender:enemy unit} — no modify-might/onAttacker step (matches the known test.failing in ogs-008-024.test.ts)
